text:
Nora Kim: Post-demo notes from Skylark onboarding — collecting product asks and a renewal flag. dropping raw snippets for triage.
Jules Park: thanks Nora. quick TL;DR?
Nora Kim: TL;DR: (1) customers want per-job cost estimates in the UI before running heavy inference jobs, (2) they request embedding reuse config (dedupe + TTL), (3) unexpected token spikes on multimodal routes causing bill spikes. Renewal note: theyre on a pilot; finance wants predictability before committing.
Carlos Mendez: adding quote: 'we budget per-project, not per-route, so spikes are killing our monthly cap.'
Priya Rao: re: per-job estimate - UX could show an "Estimated cost" card based on model, seq len, and tokens; backend needs an estimator endpoint.
Nora Kim: Skylark provided an example job: large doc -> split -> embed -> index. they ran 120 docs and token count doubled due to metadata expansion. sample payload: 
```json
{"job_id":"skylark-2026-03","docs":120,"avg_tokens_per_doc":1800,"metadata_expand":true}
```
Carlos Mendez: sounds like we should offer a preview that computes expected tokens after our preprocessor. otherwise customers assume input tokens == billed tokens.
Jules Park: prioritization suggestion: estimator endpoint (P1) because it directly reduces churn risk; embedding reuse TTL/dedupe (P2) as cost optimization; root cause token inflation on multimodal pipeline (investigate, P1 if it's billing-inaccurate).
Priya Rao: engineering estimate: estimator API + UI hook = 1 sprint backend + 1 sprint frontend (can do a thin MVP with conservative estimates). embedding dedupe feature = 2 sprints to integrate into pipeline + metrics. multimodal token audit = 3 engineer-days to produce telemetry and a follow-up bug fix if needed.
Nora Kim: customer asked for three things in order: "estimate before run", "stop duplicate embedding compute", "alert when monthly forecast > 120% of baseline".
Carlos Mendez: renewal risk: flagging as medium-high; offer interim workaround: supply a manual estimate from CS + temporary quota guard.
Jules Park: action items: (1) Nora to email Skylark with interim workaround and ask for sample job JSONs. (2) I will open a product ticket for "per-job cost estimator (MVP)" and tag it P1. (3) Priya to scope estimator API and outline required telemetry fields. (4) Carlos to propose a temporary quota policy we can enable for pilot accounts.
billing-bot: Invoice alert configured: customer skylark@example.com -> threshold 120% projected.
Priya Rao: quick prototype approach: reuse our tokenizer service to run sample through preprocessors and return token delta; expose /v1/estimate-cost.
Nora Kim: customer-facing note we can send this week: sample CSV + one-off estimate and offer to run a dry-run on staging.
Carlos Mendez: I'll draft the email and include rate-limit/quota advice.
Jules Park: will attach this thread to the roadmap ticket. please add any additional quotes or logs here.
Nora Kim: uploading demo recording and sample job JSON to drive now. thanks team. :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: ping me if you want the prototype for the demo next week.
Carlos Mendez: keeping renewal on watch; will propose another touchpoint with finance team if costs remain uncertain.
Nora Kim: end of notes.
